newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade Doubletree, Excite options.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade Doubletree, Excite options.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Wednesday it would list options on Doubletree Corp and Excite Inc on January 20.
The PSE said Doubletree options would have opening strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, with initial expirations in February, March, April and July.
The stock ended down 1/2 at 43-1/2 on Wednesday.
The options have been allocated to lead market maker Sheldon Kahn of Pax West, the exchange said.
Excite options would open with strikes of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2 and initial expirations in February, March, May and August, the exchange said.
The exchange said Excite options have been allocated to lead market maker Joel Westle of Westle Securities.
The Chicago Board Options Exchange also plans to trade Doubletree and Excite options, and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange plans to trade Excite options.
